source.name: LaTeX Project tagging status
source.note: A converted copy of the LaTeX Project’s tagging-status.yml: fields kept are name, type, status, comments, subpackages; group and link are added by Tagging Doctor.
source.licence: LaTeX Project Public License, version 1.3c or later

entries.name: a4
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the `a4paper` class option or the geometry package.

entries.name: a4wide
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the geometry package instead.

entries.name: ae
entries.comment: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

entries.name: aecompl
entries.comment: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

entries.name: aeguill
entries.comment: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

entries.name: aboensis
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to unicode.

entries.name: academicons
entries.comment: Symbols need ToUnicode values or Alt text.

entries.name: accents
entries.comment: amsmath must be loaded before accents. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: achemso
entries.comment: Note the achemso class is not compatible, only the package.

entries.name: acronym
entries.comment: List of acronyms is tagged as list rather than TOC and dotfill should be tagged as artifact.

entries.name: adfarrows
entries.comment: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

entries.name: adfbullets
entries.comment: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

entries.name: adforn
entries.comment: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

entries.name: adjustbox
entries.comment: `varwidth` and `stack` keys rely on currently-incompatible varwidth package. Does not register `alt`, `artifact`, or `actualtext` keys for `\adjincludegraphics`. `\adjustbox` creates empty tags.

entries.name: adobeornaments
entries.comment: Symbols missing ActualText or ToUnicode values. Package not in texlive.

entries.name: afterpackage
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the package hooks provided by the kernel.

entries.name: alnumsec
entries.comment: Should not use mathematical Greek letters in section numbers.

entries.name: amsbsy
entries.comment: pmb produces extra tags from typesetting argument three times

entries.name: amscd
entries.comment: Breaks with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: amsfonts
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: amsmidx
entries.comment: Meant for use with amsbook which is currently incompatible.

entries.name: amssymb
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: amsxtra
entries.comment: `\accentedsymbol` not supported by luamml and errors with mathml-SE.

entries.name: anysize
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the typearea or geometry packages.

entries.name: appendixnumberbeamer
entries.comment: beamer is not a supported class.

entries.name: arabi
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use luatex with arabluatex or babel; see the babel [guide](https://latex3.github.io/babel/guides/locale-arabic.html).

entries.name: arabtex
entries.comment: Use lualatex and babel with OpenType fonts instead.

entries.name: aramaic
entries.comment: Aramaic text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: arrayjob
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the arrayjobx package instead.

entries.name: atableau
entries.comment: No way to add alt text to tableau used outside a `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: atbegshi
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the shipout hooks provided by the kernel.

entries.name: atveryend
entries.comment: This is an obsolete package. The hooks it defines are available directly from the LaTeX kernel when using the `\AddToHook` interface.

entries.name: aurical
entries.comment: Some characters with `\Fontamici` are not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: autoaligne
entries.comment: Tags each character as a separate formula. No luamml support.

entries.name: autobreak
entries.comment: Does not error but the package functionality is disabled with tagging.

entries.name: axessibility
entries.comment: Loads tagpdf but it is not compatible with the current version. Its patches clash with the math module.

entries.name: axodraw2
entries.comment: `axopicture` environment can take same optional argument as `picture` to set `alt`, `artifact`, etc.

entries.name: babel
entries.comment: Most likely compatible for many languages, but this needs tests for each language, so listed as unknown for now. For individual languages and dialects see the entries babel-xxx [in the full list](full#babel).

entries.name: babel-esperanto
entries.comment: Shorthand `^h` does not correctly map to Unicode with pdflatex.

entries.name: babel-spanish
entries.comment: Active character issues with natbib, can be disabled with `shorthands=off. `\sptext` not ideally tagged.

entries.name: bbm
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: bbold
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: bboldx
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: beamerposter
entries.comment: beamer is not a supported class.

entries.name: bearwear
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: bezier
entries.comment: Empty compatibility package, can be removed from the preamble

entries.name: bibunits
entries.comment: No links with hyperref. No Reference structure for links.

entries.name: bicaption
entries.comment: Relies on currently incompatible caption package.

entries.name: bidi
entries.comment: Requires xetex so tests are excluded.

entries.name: bigdelim
entries.comment: Relies on incompatible multirow. No luamml support in math mode.

entries.name: bm
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: booktabs
entries.comment: Requires the firstaid module which contains a fix.

entries.name: boxedminipage
entries.comment: drawn box is tagged as Path instead of artifact

entries.name: breakurl
entries.comment: Requires latex->dvips->ps2pdf. For this reason, tests are excluded.

entries.name: breqn
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: bussproofs
entries.comment: Tagged as normal text instead of figure with Alt text.

entries.name: cancel
entries.comment: No luamml support. Text mode commands are tagged incorrectly.

entries.name: caption
entries.comment: the configurations from the package are overwritten by the tagging code. Issue when hyperref and both listoffigures are used.

entries.name: caption2
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the caption package instead.

entries.name: causets
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text is given to `\pcauset`, etc.

entries.name: cellspace
entries.comment: Package is broken with p-type columns with current LaTeX. --- Fixed in 2026

entries.name: chemfig
entries.comment: Figures are tagged as a sequence of many formulas. Errors with lua-unicode-math.

entries.name: chronosys
entries.comment: `chronology` environment does not produce a Figure.

entries.name: circledsteps
entries.comment: Missing TextDecoration attributes. No luamml support in math mode.

entries.name: cmll
entries.comment: No luamml support. Must be loaded before lua-unicode-math.

entries.name: collectbox
entries.comment: Limited by current tagging of boxes.

entries.name: colortbl
entries.comment: Breaks tagging if tables are nested. #90 issue with longtable fixed at the last release. #749 fixed in newest colortbl version.

entries.name: concrete
entries.comment: Simply loads the beton and euler packages. The latter is incompatible with unicode-math.

entries.name: continue
entries.comment: Continuation marks should be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: contour
entries.comment: Typesets the content many times which produces incorrect tags.

entries.name: cookingsymbols
entries.comment: Missing ActualText or ToUnicode values for symbols.

entries.name: cprotect
entries.comment: Breaks TOC and errors in math mode.

entries.name: csquotes
entries.comment: Extra space after opening quote with luatex.

entries.name: csvsimple
entries.comment: `\csvautotabularray` etc. are not supported since tabularray is currently incompatible.

entries.name: ctex
entries.comment: Option `heading=true` breaks section heading tagging. Same problem with classes ctexart, ctexbook, and ctexrep. Breaks math environments.

entries.name: cypriot
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: dashrule
entries.comment: `\hdashrule` commands should be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: dcolumn
entries.comment: `d` columns are set as text not math, which is arguably correct, but needs some further evaluation.

entries.name: dcpic
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to diagram; see pictex.

entries.name: derivative
entries.comment: luamml support of `\odif` etc. is not ideal.

entries.name: doclicense
entries.comment: Graphics need Alt text. Metadata is set with hyperxmp which tagging code disables.

entries.name: domaincoloring
entries.comment: Alt text must be specified in the `grfOptions` key of `\DomainColoring`.

entries.name: dotlessj
entries.comment: Symbols not correctly mapped to unicode.

entries.name: dpfloat
entries.comment: Package is not compatible with the current LaTeX output routine.

entries.name: dsfont
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: dsserif
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: dutchcal
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: dynkin-diagrams
entries.comment: No way to pass Alt text to `\dynkin` or a `dynkinDiagram` outside of a `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: ebgaramond-maths
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: ebproof
entries.comment: Tagging and mathml of `prooftree` is not correct.

entries.name: eepic
entries.comment: Does not work with pdflatex or lualatex. Suggested replacement is the package bxeepic.

entries.name: efbox
entries.comment: No errors but there is no tagging information about the boxes.

entries.name: embrac
entries.comment: Inserts and removes unnecessary spaces at pdf level.

entries.name: emo
entries.comment: Symbols disappear in tags with lualatex. Inserts images that need actualtext or ToUnicode values with pdflatex.

entries.name: emoji
entries.comment: Compatible with some emoji fonts, however default Noto Color fonts are not supported at the PDF tagging level.

entries.name: endnotes
entries.comment: Does not error but `\endnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

entries.name: endnotesj
entries.comment: Does not error but `\endnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

entries.name: enotez
entries.comment: `\pagenote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s. `\ref` in `\endnotemark` produces parent-child warnings.

entries.name: enumitem
entries.comment: The package itself can't be loaded right now. However, the tagging code supports (most of) the document-level syntax of `enumitem`, so that one can use, for example, `\begin{itemize}[...]` out of the box.

entries.name: enverb
entries.comment: Works with fancyvrb environments but not standard `verbatim`.

entries.name: everypage
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the hooks provided by the kernel.

entries.name: epigraph
entries.comment: Requires a blank line after `\epigraph` command.

entries.name: epsdice
entries.comment: Missing Alt text for dice graphics.

entries.name: epsf
entries.comment: Obsolete. Images not tagged as Figure. No way to add Alt or ActualText.

entries.name: eqnlines
entries.comment: Works with minor deficiencies. Uses adaption of latex-lab-math.ltx internal macro `\math_register_halign_env:nn` to grab math contents. Adjustments towards final tagging interfaces likely necessary.

entries.name: esint
entries.comment: amsmath must be loaded before esint. Symbols overwritten by unicode-math.

entries.name: eso-pic
entries.comment: Content of `\AddToShipoutPictureBG` should always be Artifact.

entries.name: esstixbb
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: esstixcal
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: esstixfrak
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: etruscan
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: eucal
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: eufrak
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: euler
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: eulervm
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: eurosym
entries.comment: `\euro` not correctly mapped to Unicode symbol.

entries.name: expl3
entries.comment: Legacy package. Now built into the kernel.

entries.name: exscale
entries.comment: Currently errors with unicode-math and mathml-SE.

entries.name: extpfeil
entries.comment: Incomplete luamml support. Must be loaded before unicode-math.

entries.name: extsizes
entries.comment: Just defines sizes so should not cause any trouble.

entries.name: faktor
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: fancyheadings
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the fancyhdr package instead.

entries.name: fdsymbol
entries.comment: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: filecontents
entries.comment: Obsolete. The `filecontents` environment is now provided by the kernel.

entries.name: filehook
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the file hooks provided by the kernel.

entries.name: fitch
entries.comment: Proper tagging requires the package is loaded with `[arrayenv=tabular]` and not used in math mode. Result is well-tagged but not yet accessible. See documentation.

entries.name: fix2col
entries.comment: Obsolete. Does nothing with a current LaTeX.

entries.name: fixltx2e
entries.comment: This is an obsolete package which should not be needed

entries.name: florilegium
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text or ActualText to inline ornaments.

entries.name: fncychap
entries.comment: Compatible when used with a -dev format or with a LaTeX release of 2026/11/01 or newer.

entries.name: fonetika
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: fontawesome5
entries.comment: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

entries.name: fontawesome6
entries.comment: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

entries.name: fontawesome7
entries.comment: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

entries.name: footnote
entries.comment: See footnotehyper for a compatible replacement.

entries.name: footnoterange
entries.comment: Footnote label i-j incorrectly tagged as normal text. hyperref support is broken since it relies on the existence of an `Hfootnote` counter which tagging-version does not provide.

entries.name: footnpag
entries.comment: Footnote tagging is correct but breaks footnotes in `\maketitle`. Tests excluded as loops after error.

entries.name: ext.tagging
entries.comment: Tags forest trees via Alt added on surrounding Figure.

entries.name: fourier
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: fouriernc
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: framed
entries.comment: Title in `titled-frame` environment is lost. Content after page break is lost with pdftex and xetex.

entries.name: frcursive
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: froufrou
entries.comment: Ornaments should be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: fwlw
entries.comment: Words printed in header/footer should be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: gelasiomath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: gensymb
entries.comment: Errors if loaded after unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: gentium
entries.comment: This package was removed from texlive.

entries.name: german
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the `german` option of babel.

entries.name: ghsystem
entries.comment: Uses math where it doesn't need to. `\ghspic` should have Alt text by default.

entries.name: glossaries
entries.comment: An old issue appears to be fixed.

entries.name: gmp
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text or Artifact status to `mpost` figures used directly. This can be done with `\usempost`, however.

entries.name: grabbox
entries.comment: Boxes are not yet supported by the tagging code.

entries.name: graphbox
entries.comment: Inserts empty Div after every Figure.

entries.name: graphicx
entries.comment: Rather than `\includegraphics[whatever]{whatever}` one should now write `\includegraphics[whatever, alt={This is the alternative text.}]{whatever}` The alternative text will be ignored if tagging is not used. It seems that draft mode doesn’t work at present. An old issue with height appears to be fixed.

entries.name: graphpap
entries.comment: tagging passes validation but is sub-optimal

entries.name: greek4cbc
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: greek6cbc
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: grmath
entries.comment: amsmath must be loaded before grmath. Not compatible with luatex, hence no luamml support.

entries.name: harvard
entries.comment: No links with hyperref. No Reference structure for links.

entries.name: here
entries.comment: Obsolete. Just loads the float package.

entries.name: hieroglf
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: hypcap
entries.comment: The tagging code already moves anchors to the top of floats so this package is unnecessary. package updated

entries.name: hyperref
entries.comment: Forms not supported; use l3pdffield-testphase for forms.

entries.name: hyperxmp
entries.comment: Incompatible with PDF management, loading is suppressed. XMP-metadata are handled by the kernel code.

entries.name: isotope
entries.comment: Tagging of isotopes in text mode is not ideal.

entries.name: incgraph
entries.comment: `alt`, `artifact`, and `actualtext` keys can be used in second optional argument of `\incgraph`, `\incmultigraph`, and `\incmultipages`.

entries.name: indxcite
entries.comment: See harvard and index packages. Not distributed with texlive.

entries.name: inputenc
entries.comment: Should not be needed with new documents.

entries.name: inputenx
entries.comment: Should not be needed with new documents.

entries.name: iwonamath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: jigsaw
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: karnaugh-map
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to the diagrams.

entries.name: keytheorems
entries.comment: tcolorbox theorems disabled when tagging is loaded. `headformat` key not fully implemented with tagging. `auto-qed` not fully compatible with tagging.

entries.name: kpfonts
entries.comment: Loads kpfonts-otf with unicode engine, required for producing mathml.

entries.name: l3draw
entries.comment: Not meant for document-level use. See hawkdraw for a compatible user interface to l3draw.

entries.name: l3keys2e
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the option handling commands provided by the kernel.

entries.name: latexrelease
entries.comment: Rolling the LaTeX format too far back will result in the loss of necessary support code for tagging, rolling forward should work.

entries.name: layout
entries.comment: Provides alt text for diagram but needs better tagging for table of dimensions.

entries.name: layouts
entries.comment: Provides alt text for diagram but needs better tagging for table of dimensions.

entries.name: letltxmacro
entries.comment: Superseded by `\NewCommandCopy` etc. provided by the kernel.

entries.name: lettrine
entries.comment: Provides `actualtext` key for use with `image` key.

entries.name: libertinust1math
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: liftarm
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: lilyglyphs
entries.comment: Symbols missing Alt text or Unicode mappings.

entries.name: linearb
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: lineno
entries.comment: Loses line numbers and line numbers are not tagged correctly. See lualineno for a compatible alternative.

entries.name: listings
entries.comment: Mostly compatible; open questions about frames and `mathescape`.

entries.name: longtable
entries.comment: A longtable with page breaks works with pdftex only if at least latex-dev from February 2025 is used.

entries.name: longtwocolumn
entries.comment: Fully compatible with lualatex. Content lost with pdflatex.

entries.name: luadraw
entries.comment: One of the TikZ keys `alt`, `actualtext`, or `artifact` must be given in `pictureoptions`

entries.name: luainputenc
entries.comment: Should not be needed with new documents.

entries.name: lualineno
entries.comment: Content with tagged structure in line numbers must have tagging suspended. Regular line numbers are automatically tagged as artifacts.

entries.name: luamesh
entries.comment: Missing way to add Alt text to underlying mplibcode or tikz environments.

entries.name: luamml
entries.comment: Should not need to be loaded directly. Loaded with `tagging=on` when luatex is detected.

entries.name: luamplib
entries.comment: Offers several keys for figures including `alt` and `artifact`.

entries.name: luatexbase
entries.comment: Legacy package. Functionality built into the kernel.

entries.name: luatexja
entries.comment: Some extension packages may not be compatible, e.g. luatexja-ruby.

entries.name: luatexko
entries.comment: Package provides tagging support for `\ruby`, `\dotemph`, `\uline`, and other underline-type commands.

entries.name: lucidabr
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support. Use lucida-otf with lualatex for full compatibility.

entries.name: MnSymbol
entries.comment: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: makecell
entries.comment: Interaction with incompatible multirow package not yet supported. `\diaghead` command uses `picture` environment that is tagged as a figure.

entries.name: mathabx
entries.comment: Must be loaded after amsmath. Math symbols are not sensibly mapped to unicode. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathalpha
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathastext
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathdesign
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathpazo
entries.comment: A pdftex engine bug has been fixed. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathpple
entries.comment: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `mathpazo`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathptm
entries.comment: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathptmx
entries.comment: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mathstone
entries.comment: No luamml support. Incompatible with unicode-math.

entries.name: mathtime
entries.comment: No luamml support. Incompatible with unicode-math.

entries.name: mathtools
entries.comment: `mathic` key produces errors. `centercolon` incompatible with unicode-math. luamml support is limited to `multlined` and `\shortintertext`.

entries.name: mattens
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: mdsymbol
entries.comment: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: memoize-ext
entries.comment: Adds sockets to the utilisation of externs created by Memoize. actualtext/alt/artifact supported for TikZ pictures.

entries.name: menukeys
entries.comment: None of the formatting is represented at the tag level; spaces between keywords are lost.

entries.name: metsymb
entries.comment: Symbols missing ToUnicode or Alt text.

entries.name: midfloat
entries.comment: No longer included in texlive, so tests excluded

entries.name: minted
entries.comment: Listings not tagged properly. See fvextra and fancyvrb.

entries.name: movie15
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the media9 package instead.

entries.name: multilang
entries.comment: Argument structure is not recognised once tagging enabled

entries.name: multind
entries.comment: Does not use section command for index headings. Not distributed with texlive.

entries.name: nabatean
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: nath
entries.comment: Incompatibly redefines nearly all math commands.

entries.name: ncccropbox
entries.comment: Crop marks are tagged as Path.

entries.name: newproof
entries.comment: Errors with 2026 format. Implements proofs as lists so tagging is not ideal.

entries.name: newpxmath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: newtxmath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: newtxsf
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: newunicodechar
entries.comment: Needs a way to support ActualText for characters.

entries.name: ngerman
entries.comment: Obsolete. Use the `ngerman` option of babel.

entries.name: nicefrac
entries.comment: Text-mode fractions are implemented as a sequence of formulas.

entries.name: nicematrix
entries.comment: Simple text-mode tabulars are tagged reasonably well. No luamml support.

entries.name: nidanfloat
entries.comment: Package is broken with current LaTeX independent of tagging.

entries.name: notomath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: numprint
entries.comment: In text mode, printed numbers are a mix of text and math.

entries.name: oands
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: old-arrows
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: oldprsn
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: oubraces
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: overcite
entries.comment: Just loads cite package with the `superscript` option.

entries.name: overpic
entries.comment: No way to tag as Artifact or with Alt text. Argument of `Overpic` cannot contain arbitrary content like tabular.

entries.name: pagecolor
entries.comment: Interaction with crop package not supported until crop is made compatible.

entries.name: pagenote
entries.comment: Does not error but `\pagenote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

entries.name: parnotes
entries.comment: Does not error but `\parnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

entries.name: pdfoverlay
entries.comment: pdf added to shipout/background so corresponding tag appears at end of page

entries.name: pdfpages
entries.comment: Creates duplicated structures as graphics are processed more than once in trial typesetting. Correct tagging of multipage includes unclear.

entries.name: pdfrender
entries.comment: Only works with luatex and pdftex.

entries.name: pdfx
entries.comment: Incompatible with PDF-management, loading is suppressed. Standards should be set with `\DocumentMetadata` keys.

entries.name: pgf-pie
entries.comment: Compatible if `alt` text given to containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: pgf-spectra
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to spectra; poor tagging for `\pgfspectratable`.

entries.name: pgf-umlcd
entries.comment: Compatible if `alt` text given to containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: pgfgantt
entries.comment: Compatible if used within a `tikzpicture` given `alt` text. No way to pass `alt` directly to a `ganttchart` environment.

entries.name: pgfornament
entries.comment: No way to add alt text to a `\pgfornament`.

entries.name: pgfplots
entries.comment: Compatibility depends on tikz but also needs its own adjustments.

entries.name: pgfplotstable
entries.comment: Table tagging is correct but any interaction with pgfplots is not yet supported.

entries.name: pgfrcs
entries.comment: Relies on patches in pdfmanagement to make pgfrcs resource management compatible.

entries.name: phoenician
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: pifont
entries.comment: The ToUnicode values are incorrect in tl2025 luatex, they are fixed in tl2026.

entries.name: pigpen
entries.comment: With pdftex, spaces are lost. Tagged as the input, not cipher, text.

entries.name: pmboxdraw
entries.comment: Symbols are not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: poetry
entries.comment: Tagging of each line and line number as its own `<Part>` is not ideal. `\titleauthorpoem` errors.

entries.name: polyomino
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: progressbar
entries.comment: No way to pass alt text to underlying tikzpicture.

entries.name: prooftrees
entries.comment: Depends on forest-ext. Note tableaux are syntactic not semantic. Tagging generated from content added to Alt on surrounding Figure.

entries.name: protosem
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: pstricks
entries.comment: Possible compatibility is only with lualatex; dvips cannot properly support PDF/UA. Offers `alt`, `actualtext`, `artifact`, and `correct-BBox` keys, however these seem not to work. Not tagged as figures.

entries.name: pxfonts
entries.comment: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newpxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: pxpic
entries.comment: pixpic's should be tagged as figures with Alt text.

entries.name: pyluatex
entries.comment: Test file requires shell escape and is excluded.

entries.name: pythontex
entries.comment: Verbatim environments not tagged correctly. See fvextra.

entries.name: rank-2-roots
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text is given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: rawfonts
entries.comment: Should not be used in new documents.

entries.name: realboxes
entries.comment: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. `\Parbox` produces parent-child warnings. Graphics and dashbox macros not tagged correctly.

entries.name: remreset
entries.comment: Obsolete. Functionality now in the kernel.

entries.name: romanbar
entries.comment: `\Romanbar` produces rules that should be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: runic
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: sansmath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: sansmathaccent
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: sansmathfonts
entries.comment: Symbols in math mode are not mapped correctly to unicode. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: sarabian
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: schemata
entries.comment: Schema are tagged as math but there is no luamml support.

entries.name: scsnowman
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text or ActualText to snowmen.

entries.name: sectionbreak
entries.comment: Section break marks are tagged; should probably be Artifacts.

entries.name: selinput
entries.comment: Only works with pdftex. Should not be necessary in new documents.

entries.name: setouterhbox
entries.comment: Only works with lualatex when tagging is loaded.

entries.name: sfmath
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: shapepar
entries.comment: Test currently excluded as it loops with pdftex.

entries.name: showkeys
entries.comment: Rules drawn around labels display as Path in tags and the label in the margin is either not tagged at all (pdflatex) or as artifact (lualatex). Unproblematic for a draft, but not UA compatible.

entries.name: shuffle
entries.comment: No luamml support. `\shuffle` command overwritten by unicode-math.

entries.name: snotez
entries.comment: Sidenotes are missing `<Lbl>`s and `sidefigure`s and `sidetable`s are not tagged correctly.

entries.name: soulutf8
entries.comment: This package is obsolete. Use the soul package directly.

entries.name: spalign
entries.comment: No luamml support for `\spalignsys`. Otherwise appears compatible.

entries.name: spark-otf
entries.comment: Spark charts need to be tagged as figure with Alt text.

entries.name: sparklines
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to the `sparkline` environment.

entries.name: srcltx
entries.comment: Not useful with pdflatex or lualatex.

entries.name: starfont
entries.comment: Symbols not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: steinmetz
entries.comment: Picture used to draw symbol should be Artifact. No luamml support.

entries.name: stix
entries.comment: Obsolete, see stix2. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: stix2
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: stmaryrd
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: storebox
entries.comment: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. Loses all spaces in tags. Requires luatex85 with lualatex.

entries.name: subcaption
entries.comment: Issue when both hyperref and listoffigures are used.

entries.name: subeqn
entries.comment: Incompatible with amsmath which is loaded by the tagging code.

entries.name: subscript
entries.comment: Obsolete. The `\textsubscript` command is now provided by the kernel.

entries.name: svg
entries.comment: Missing user interface to set alt text, actualtext, artifact.

entries.name: symbats3
entries.comment: Symbols missing ActualText or ToUnicode values. Tests excluded since font not included in texlive.

entries.name: tabu
entries.comment: In theory a nice package but it is **broken** and **not maintained**. It is not compatible with current LaTeX, let alone with the tagging extensions. Do not use it for anything, unless it gets a new maintainer that brings it up to speed.

entries.name: tagging
entries.comment: This package allows conditional typesetting, i.e., tagging here means that the LaTeX source has labeled regions that you can include or exclude.

entries.name: tcolorbox
entries.comment: Simple boxes are now tagged correctly. Not yet fully supported, but some suggestions in the listed issues

entries.name: tex4ht
entries.comment: Simple files with `\DocumentMetadata` error when run with `tex4ht`.

entries.name: texosquery
entries.comment: Tests currently excluded since they depend on OS.

entries.name: textcase
entries.comment: This package is obsolete. Use the kernel `\MakeUppercase` and `\MakeLowercase`.

entries.name: textcomp
entries.comment: Package no longer needed as definitions have been moved into the kernel

entries.name: textcsc
entries.comment: Works correctly with Harbuzz renderer but not with Node.

entries.name: thmtools
entries.comment: Numbering with sibling key is wrong.

entries.name: tikz
entries.comment: Tagging code defines `alt`, `actualtext`, and `artifact` keys when tikz is loaded.

entries.name: tikz-3dplot
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikz-dependency
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `dependency` environment.

entries.name: tikz-dimline
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikz-feynman
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to `\feynmandiagram or the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikz-network
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikz-timing
entries.comment: `Use of `\timing` is compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`. Similarly for `tikztimingtable`. No way to pass Alt text to `\ exttiming` or the `T` column type of the `columntype` library.

entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-celtic
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-commutative-diagrams
entries.comment: TikZ library version of the commutative-diagrams package.

entries.comment: TikZ library version of the tikzducks package.

entries.comment: beamer is not a supported class.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-fadings

entries.name: tikzlibrary-hobby
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-knots
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-quantikz2
entries.comment: TikZ library version of the quantikz package.

entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-tikzphysics
entries.comment: TikZ library version of the tikzphysics package.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-tilings
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-tqft
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-trainmap
entries.comment: TikZ library version of the trainmap package.

entries.name: tikzlibrary-zx-calculus
entries.comment: TikZ library version of the zx-calculus package.

entries.name: tikzlings
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`. See also tikzducks.

entries.name: tikzpeople
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzphysics
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tikzpingus
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tipa
entries.comment: Symbols not correctly mapped to Unicode. Consider using tipauni instead.

entries.name: titleref
entries.comment: Incompatible with hyperref. Main functionality is broken with tagging code. Use nameref instead.

entries.name: titlesec
entries.comment: The package is partially but not yet fully emulated by the latex-lab code. See latex-lab-titlesec.pdf.

entries.name: tkz-berge
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tkz-elements
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tkz-euclide
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: tkz-graph
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: trainmap
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to a `trainmap`.

entries.name: transparent
entries.comment: Transparency across page breaks only works with luatex and pdftex.

entries.name: trimclip
entries.comment: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. `\clipbox` adds empty tags.

entries.name: tweaklist
entries.comment: Modifications of list environments are overwritten by the tagging code.

entries.name: txfonts
entries.comment: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: txfontsb
entries.comment: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: ucs
entries.comment: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents. Ignored entirely with Unicode engines.

entries.name: ugarite
entries.comment: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

entries.name: unicodefonttable
entries.comment: Headings are incorrectly marked as data cells.

entries.name: units
entries.comment: No luamml support. Depends on incompatible nicefrac.

entries.name: upgreek
entries.comment: Most commands overwritten by unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: uri
entries.comment: Produces empty containers after links if hyperref loaded.

entries.name: utf8
entries.comment: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

entries.name: varwidth
entries.comment: Tagging structure looks ok, but the formatting is wrong when the tagging code is used.

entries.name: vector
entries.comment: Not distributed with texlive. No luamml support for `\uvec` and `\uuvec` with `wavy` package option.

entries.name: venndiagram
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the `tikzoptions` key of the `venndiagram3sets` or `venndiagram2sets` environment.

entries.name: verbatim
entries.comment: Fully compatible other than the package's documented method of defining new verbatim environments.

entries.name: verse
entries.comment: `\flagverse` and line numbers not tagged ideally.

entries.name: warpcol
entries.comment: Tests excluded as loops (no error raised).

entries.name: wasysym
entries.comment: Missing ToUnicode for text symbols. amsmath must be loaded before wasysym.

entries.name: wheelchart
entries.comment: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: worldflags
entries.comment: No way to add Alt text to a `\worldflag` command. Compatible if used as `\pic`s within a `tikzpicture` given Alt text.

entries.name: wrapstuff
entries.comment: Errors outright with pdftex. The `width` and `type` keys produce parent-child warnings, so `\caption` cannot be used in the `wrapstuff` environment.

entries.name: xcite
entries.comment: This package now simply loads xr.

entries.name: xevlna
entries.comment: Tests excluded as package requires xetex.

entries.name: xfp
entries.comment: Legacy package. Functionality built in to the kernel.

entries.name: xhfill
entries.comment: Drawn rules should be tagged as Artifacts. Content disappears with pdftex.

entries.name: xistercian
entries.comment: Missing ToUnicode or ActualText for symbols.

entries.name: xltabular
entries.comment: An xltabular with page breaks works with pdftex only if at least latex from June 2025 is used.

entries.name: xparse
entries.comment: Legacy package. Functionality built in to the kernel.

entries.name: xpinyin
entries.comment: Missing correct Ruby annotation. Only works with pdftex and xetex.

entries.name: xr-hyper
entries.comment: Package now identical to xr, thus not necessary any longer when hyperref is used.

entries.name: xtab
entries.comment: Starts a new table at page breaks which is not ideal. Captions error.

entries.name: xtemplate
entries.comment: Legacy package. Templates are now supported in the kernel.

entries.name: xy
entries.comment: In text mode, no tagging occurs for `\xymatrix`. No luamml support. Requires luatex85 with luatex and output is wrong. unicode-math must be loaded after xy.

entries.name: yhmath
entries.comment: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

entries.name: youngtab
entries.comment: No luamml support. Diagrams in text mode need Alt text and for rules to be tagged as Artifacts.

entries.name: yquant
entries.comment: Compatible if `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

entries.name: zhnumber
entries.comment: Tests excluded because the results are font-dependent.

entries.name: zref
entries.comment: Most of the zref-* packages are compatible. Some still need to be checked.

entries.name: abntex2
entries.comment: Extension of the incompatible memoir class.

entries.name: amsart
entries.comment: Currently `\maketitle` and `\@starttoc` will need adjustment. Used by project example arxiv3.

entries.name: amsldoc
entries.comment: See some needed adjustments in project example `amsldoc`.

entries.name: apa7
entries.comment: `jou` mode does not error but tagging is far from ideal. `man` and `stu` modes error outright. Loads incompatible threeparttable package.

entries.name: beamer
entries.comment: Internals rebox material repeatedly in a way that is not compatible with any form of tagging support. The ltx-talk class is being developed as an alternative, and is recommended for new tagged presentations.

entries.name: extarticle
entries.comment: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use article + extsizes.

entries.name: extbook
entries.comment: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use book + extsizes.

entries.name: extletter
entries.comment: Tagging is not ideal. See letter class.

entries.name: extproc
entries.comment: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use proc + extsizes.

entries.name: extreport
entries.comment: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use report + extsizes.

entries.name: ltugboat
entries.comment: `\bull` still needs proper Unicode mapping. `\ruled` in `verbatim` optional arg is not supported in the future.

entries.name: ltx-talk
entries.comment: A new class developed from scratch for tagging; intended as a substitute for the popular beamer class for presentations

entries.name: memoir
entries.comment: Some code showing the needed adjustments can be found in the [bible example](https://github.com/latex3/tagging-project/blob/main/project-examples/ASV/bible.tex).

entries.name: minimal
entries.comment: The minimal class is not useful even for MWE's. Don't use it.

entries.name: novel
entries.comment: Would need to use use pdfmanagement for XMP metadata and not error when array is loaded, among other fixes.

entries.name: oblivoir
entries.comment: Extension of the incompatible memoir class.

entries.name: revtex4-1
entries.comment: Obsolete class: new documents should use 4-2.

entries.name: simplecv
entries.comment: Tagging of title and headers is not ideal.

entries.name: standalone
entries.comment: With the standalone class, content is lost at pdf level due to being boxed. Using the standalone package to input standalone files is compatible.
